verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry and usage tracking is a fair privacy question for a SaaS accounting product like Puzzle, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions telemetry, analytics, usage tracking, or any opt-out control. The cited material covers accounting features, data export, the API and MCP, none of which addresses the story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
